speech_verification.heard: For centuries, historians believed everyone in Herculaneum escaped the volcano. That comforting narrative shattered when archaeologists excavated the ancient shoreline. Three hundred skeletons were discovered huddled inside vaulted stone boathouses. Victims waited for rescue boats that never arrived. Superheated pyroclastic surge rushed down the mountain. Extreme thermal shock caused instant death for everyone by the shore. No one in the town knew the volcano was about to erupt.

notes.hook: The first line is a bit slow and descriptive; it doesn't grab attention immediately.
notes.clarity: The narrative flow is simple and easy to follow.
notes.payoff: The revelation of the skeletons in the boathouses provides a solid payoff to the hook.
notes.visuals: The images are generally striking and relevant, though some are paintings.
notes.loop: The last line doesn't lead seamlessly back into the first line.
notes.accuracy: Beat 7 makes a claim that is not supported by the research provided, and it contradicts the logic of the story.

rewrite: Beat 1: '300 skeletons proved that everyone in Herculaneum didn't escape the volcano.'
Beat 7: 'For centuries, the world believed they had all gotten away.'
rounds.better_than_last: This Short has a clearer thematic arc and a more satisfying payoff than ep054.
